scenario_description:
The case that does produce a 429, and the emitter sees it. When the shard inbox is full and stays full past the admission deadline, the reply is 429 with an accepted count and a rejected count, and the admitted events are not rolled back. SPEC.md property 2 and "Wire and backpressure".
Saturation is produced by configuring SCALE.md's own parameters, not by a probe-only knob: a tiny inbox and a one-millisecond deadline mean a batch larger than the inbox cannot be fully admitted at any loop speed. That makes the property reachable without a 3.4-million-events-per-second flood from Python. It also means the scenario tests the admission path rather than the loop's throughput; see HARNESS.md "What this corpus does not cover".
